items.desc: The airline’s only operational widebody remains in Narita after an engine problem affected a flight carrying 226 passengers, with Doha services also at risk.

items.desc: Torrential rain triggered flooding in Jajarkot’s Nalgad area, disrupting transport on the Bheri Corridor and destroying homes, businesses and other structures.

items.desc: Rescued after nine days trapped in a hydropower tunnel, Sanjay Sah returned to his family in a village still mourning workers missing after last month’s disaster.

items.desc: A narrow early lead for Magdalena Andersson’s centre-left bloc could end Ulf Kristersson’s four-year government and put Sweden’s hardening migration policies under review.

items.desc: Bhasthi discusses preserving the soul, musicality and rhythm of a language, and why a translation should not erase its cultural roots.

items.title: Beijing signals support for rebuilding flood-ravaged Rasuwagadhi route
items.desc: Nepal has sought Chinese assistance to rebuild the 16-km Syaphrubesi-Rasuwagadhi road, while the government prepares a temporary track to restore access to the border crossing.

items.desc: Countries certify a battery before it’s sold. Nepal certifies almost nothing. That gap needs fixing.

items.desc: Rough seas complicate rescue as authorities search for passengers still unaccounted for.
